headline: Board reviews Policy 2.8 action, Teaching & Learning Plan, and first readings on home study and student expression policies.
summary: The board will discuss routine financial reports and hiring recommendations, vote on Policy 2.8 Communication and Support to the Board, and hold first readings on Policy C6 Participation of Home Study Students and Policy C11 Student Freedom of Expression. The meeting also includes a Teaching & Learning Plan discussion and committee updates.
